entities.summary:
Theater Chemnitz is a German municipal theater organization based in Chemnitz. Performances of opera, ballet, plays, symphonic concerts, and puppet theater take place in its three main venues:Opernhaus Chemnitz 
Stadthalle Chemnitz 
Schauspielhaus Chemnitz. Chemnitz Opera is a opera house in Europe, established in 1909. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
